6 manly rules that make
you insanely attractive

1. If You're Invited to Dinner...
Never Arrive Empty-Handed:
• Bring dessert or flowers.
• Offer to clear the table.
• Text thanks the next day.

2. If a Friend Is Moving...
Show Up Early:
• Be there at 8, not 11.
• Carry the heavy boxes.
• The pizza is on you.

3. If Someone Says a Word
Wrong... Let It Go:
• Don't correct them in public.
• Nobody likes the smartest
guy at the table.

4. If the Talk Turns to Something
You Don't Know... Get Curious:
• Ask real questions.
• Listen more than you talk.
• Look it up that night.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. If the Talk Turns to Something
You Don't Know... Get Curious:
• Ask real questions.
• Listen more than you talk.
• Learn about it that night
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. If You Borrow His Car...
Return It Better:
• Full tank.
• Clean inside.
• Say thanks to his face.

6. If You Were Wrong...
Say It First:
• "You're right. I was wrong."
• No "but" after it.
• Respect grows when ego shrinks.
